title: Egg Truck – Free Physics Driving Game (One Button)
description: Play Egg Truck free in your browser: hold to drive, release to brake, and carry a fragile egg over hills and ramps without cracking it.
body: Hold to drive, release to brake, and carry a very nervous egg as far as you can. Every jump is a choice: land flat and the egg is safe, land hard and it cracks.
One button, no text, runs of one to three minutes, and it works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and desktops. Your best distance is saved automatically.
New here? Read how to play and the tips to go further.

title: How to Play Egg Truck – Controls and Rules
description: Egg Truck controls in one line: hold to drive, release to brake. Learn the rules, the cracks system and how flags work.
body: Egg Truck uses a single input. Hold the mouse button, your finger or the Space bar to drive forward. Release to brake.
In the air the same button controls the truck's angle: holding tips it back, releasing tips it forward. Use it to land with both wheels at the same time.
The egg cracks when it slams into the truck bed. The little egg icon under your star counter shows how many cracks it has: the third crack, or any fall to the ground, ends the run.
Distance is measured in metres. Every 100 m you pass a yellow flag, and stars float over hills and after ramps. Your best distance and your total stars are saved automatically.

title: Egg Truck Tips: Go Further Without Cracking the Egg
description: Seven practical tips to beat your best distance in Egg Truck: landings, ramps, bumps and when to let go.
body: Let go before the top of a ramp. Releasing just before the lip keeps the nose down and gives a flatter landing.
Land on both wheels. Watch the truck in the air and tap to correct the angle; a flat landing barely shakes the egg.
Bumps are slower than they look. Over a row of rocks, short taps beat holding the whole way.
Steep hill ahead? Build speed on the flat before it; trying to climb from a stop makes the truck wheelie.
Upside down? If the truck stays flipped for more than a second the run ends, so lean forward early.
Stars after ramps are placed along the ideal jump arc. Following them is also the safest line.
Two cracks? Slow down. A slow run that reaches the next flag beats a fast run that ends here.

title: Egg Truck for Schools and Kids – Safe, Short, No Sign-up
description: Egg Truck is a short, text-free physics game that works on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account.
h1: Egg Truck for classrooms and kids
body: Egg Truck has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. Runs last one to three minutes, which makes it a good reward between tasks.
There is no text in the game, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.
It is also a gentle introduction to physics: speed, momentum, balance and angles decide whether the egg survives each jump.
It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones, and loads in a couple of seconds (1.6 MB).

title: Egg Truck FAQ
description: Answers about Egg Truck: is it free, does it save, does it work on mobile and Chromebook, why did my egg break.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser.
Does it save my progress? Yes. Your best distance and stars are stored in your browser.
Does it work on phones and Chromebooks? Yes, with touch or mouse, in landscape or portrait.
Why did my egg break? Three hard hits against the truck bed, or the egg touching the ground, end the run.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.
